title: The Rosewood Parlor
subtitle: A peaceful manor interrupted by poison
description: Lord Reginald Rosewood was found dead in the estate conservatory before evening tea. Five guests and staff were scattered across the manor's east wing.

title: The Grand Antiquary
subtitle: A silent museum exhibition turned crime scene
description: Curator Professor Alistair Finch was discovered poisoned beside the centerpiece fossil in the museum's east wing. Five colleagues and patrons remained locked inside after closing.

title: The Midnight Express
subtitle: A luxury train stranded in alpine snowfall
description: The Alpine Express was stranded overnight in a remote mountain pass. Baroness von Brandt was found dead inside her private sleeper cabin. Five passengers and train crew were nearby across the train cars.

title: The Saltmarsh Beacon
subtitle: A storm-swept coastal watchtower with nowhere to run
description: A fierce storm severed Saltmarsh Island from the mainland. Veteran lighthouse keeper Captain Thaddeus Ward was discovered dead on the high lantern gallery. Six mariners and station staff were trapped inside.

title: The Blackwood Playhouse
subtitle: A final dress rehearsal silenced by tragedy
description: On the eve of opening night, tyrannical artistic director Vincent Sterling was discovered poisoned in his private dressing quarters at Blackwood Playhouse. Six members of the company were scattered across the stage and wings.
